title: Gluten-Free Peanut Butter Cookies
blurb: Simple cookies with a soft centre and crisp edges, made with just five ingredients.
steps: Heat your oven to 180°C and line a baking tray with parchment.
Put the peanut butter, sugar, egg, bicarbonate of soda and vanilla extract in a bowl and stir until completely combined.
Scoop tablespoons of the mixture and roll into twelve balls, then place them on the tray with space between each.
Press each ball gently with a fork to flatten slightly, making a criss-cross pattern on top.
Bake for 10 minutes until the edges are lightly golden but the centres still look soft.
Leave the cookies on the tray for 5 minutes to firm up, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.
